scope: R2 follow-up to the user-supplied eightieth-audit observations. Acceptance remains withdrawn. R1 and its original development failures are retained unchanged in the R1 packet.

failures.reason: The initial inline-source test bitwise-ANDed an aligned address with a boolean. That made the test false and treated stack data as an arena allocation; mvc_nested returned NIL instead of its two values. The positive corpus rejected it. The fix explicitly compares the address with zero; the same pointer/boolean check on replaced destination buffers is corrected. Exact compiler sources, generated counterexample and failing trace are retained.

The new forced-arena mutant threw the intended checked exception, but the general control runner only accepts AssertionError failures. Wrapped the zero-arena positive call in assert.doesNotThrow to make that oracle explicit. The original raw-exception log and executed sources remain retained; it was not counted as a passed control.

The first full run passed the eager corpus and copy oracle but the inherited lazy harness still accepted only arena-backed indirect roots. It rejected the new inline descriptor at mvc_mixed. Updated that harness reader to the same explicit inline extent rule as eager execution; no compiler or loader policy changed.

checks: The corrected ordinary corpus ran before the new zero-arena and direct-handoff controls were added. Boundary sizes follow the 16-byte arena header plus 130 value words rounded to 16 bytes (544); a scalar cleanup no longer requires another arena block.
native: Fresh native R6/R6a over the proposed compiler only; shared source remains at the withdrawal baseline.
metadata: Development notes were finalized after individual attempts; executed compiler and harness sources are preserved for failures.
